message.content:
Based on my research, here's a comprehensive step-by-step guide to set up a new router for WiFi access:

## Step 1: Unbox and Prepare
- Check that you have: the router unit, power adapter, Ethernet cable, and quick-start guide
- Inspect all items for damage

## Step 2: Choose the Right Location
- Place the router in a **central location** in your home
- Keep it **elevated off the ground** for better range
- Avoid metal objects, appliances, and walls that can interfere with signals

## Step 3: Connect the Hardware
1. **Connect modem to router**: Use an Ethernet cable to connect your modem to the router's **WAN/Internet port** (usually a different color like blue or yellow)
2. **Power up**: Plug the power adapter into the router and connect to an electrical outlet
3. If external antennas were provided, attach them now
4. Power on both the modem and router and wait 1-2 minutes for them to fully boot up and sync

## Step 4: Connect to the Router
You have two options:
- **Wired**: Connect your computer directly to one of the LAN ports (numbered 1, 2, 3, 4) using an Ethernet cable
- **Wireless**: Connect to the router's default WiFi network using the SSID and password printed on the sticker on the router

## Step 5: Access the Router's Admin Panel
1. Open a web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, etc.)
2. Enter the router's default IP address in the address bar. Common addresses are:
   - `192.168.1.1`
   - `192.168.0.1`
   - `192.168.1.254`
3. Press Enter
4. Log in with the default admin username and password (usually found on the router's sticker or manual). Common defaults are `admin`/`admin` or `admin`/`password`

*Alternative*: Many modern routers (like NETGEAR) offer mobile apps (e.g., Nighthawk app) that let you scan a QR code on the router for easier setup.

## Step 6: Change Default Admin Credentials
- **Immediately change** the default admin username and password
- This prevents unauthorized access to your router's settings
- Go to "System," "Administration," or "Management" section

## Step 7: Configure Your WiFi Network
1. Navigate to the **Wireless** or **WiFi** settings section
2. **Change the SSID** (network name) to something unique and memorable
3. **Set a strong WiFi password** (at least 12-16 characters with mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols)
4. **Select security protocol**: Use **WPA3** if available; otherwise use **WPA2-PSK (AES)**
5. Set up separate **2.4 GHz and 5 GHz networks** if desired (different names help identify which band you're connecting to)

## Step 8: Update Firmware
- Check for firmware updates in the router dashboard (usually under "System Tools" or "Firmware Update")
- Install any available updates for security patches and performance improvements
- Enable automatic updates if available

## Step 9: Configure Internet Connection
- Select your internet connection type (most home users use **PPPoE** for DSL or **Dynamic IP** for cable)
- If using PPPoE, enter the username and password provided by your ISP

## Step 10: Enable Security Features
- Turn on **firewall protection**
- Consider enabling **guest network** for visitors
- Set up **parental controls** if needed
- Enable **MAC address filtering** for additional security (optional)

## Step 11: Test Your Connection
- Connect multiple devices to your new WiFi network
- Test internet access, speed, and signal strength throughout your home
- Check for dead zones and consider router placement adjustments if needed

## Step 12: Save Settings and Reconnect
- Save all configuration changes
- Your router may restart automatically
- Reconnect all your devices using the new WiFi name and password

---

**Troubleshooting Tips:**
- If you can't access the admin page, double-check the IP address and ensure you're properly connected
- If no internet access, verify modem-to-router cable connection and try power cycling both devices
- For connection errors during app setup, try turning off mobile data on your smartphone

Sources:
1. https://kb.netgear.com/119/Setting-up-and-installing-your-NETGEAR-router
2. https://solar-tech-support.co.uk/brands/givenergy/setup/router-configuration/
3. https://www.oscium.com/training/change-wireless-router-settings/
4. https://posvirtual.fapam.edu.br/fapam-news/easy-router-wifi-setup-guide-1764800295
5. https://www.ecoflow.com/au/blog/how-do-you-set-up-a-router
6. https://www.fwweekly.com/2025/06/27/how-to-set-up-a-new-wifi-router-like-a-pro/
7. https://wifiwavlink.net/wavlink-router-configuration-guide/
8. https://www.sohu.com/a/922265289_362225
